groups.defect: Both membership endpoints require group_id while their routes supply id.
groups.rationale: All three describe the same routing/controller parameter mismatch in add_members and remove_member. A unified comment must cover both parameter reads.

groups.defect: totalPages overcounts by one when user_count is an exact positive multiple of limit.
groups.rationale: All four identify the same floor-plus-one calculation and its phantom trailing page. Correcting that calculation addresses every report.

groups.defect: findMembers returns undefined instead of a promise when the group name is empty.
groups.rationale: Both identify the same bare return and the resulting broken thenable contract.
